kpis.description_fr: AUM = principal moteur de fees BX. Croissance organique nette + valorisations + acquisitions. Cible 1500 Mds $ horizon 2027-28.
kpis.description_en: AUM = main BX fee driver. Net organic growth + valuations + acquisitions. Target $1500B by 2027-28.

kpis.description_fr: Fee-Earning AUM = base qui génère management fees. Sous-ensemble de Total AUM (dry powder = pas encore fee-earning).
kpis.description_en: Fee-Earning AUM = base generating management fees. Subset of Total AUM (dry powder = not yet fee-earning).

kpis.description_fr: Real Estate = plus gros segment BX. Pression cycle commercial real estate USA (offices). BREIT redemptions stabilisées en 2024.
kpis.description_en: Real Estate = BX's largest segment. Pressure from US commercial real estate cycle (offices). BREIT redemptions stabilized in 2024.

kpis.description_fr: Private Equity = corporate + tactical opportunities + secondaries. Fundraising actif malgré exit ralenti.
kpis.description_en: Private Equity = corporate + tactical opportunities + secondaries. Active fundraising despite slowed exits.

kpis.description_fr: Credit & Insurance = segment en forte croissance, alimenté par 'private credit' boom + asset-light insurance partnerships.
kpis.description_en: Credit & Insurance = fastest-growing segment, driven by private credit boom + asset-light insurance partnerships.

kpis.description_fr: Dry Powder = capital levé non encore déployé. Réservoir de futurs fees + investissements. Niveau record secteur PE.
kpis.description_en: Dry Powder = capital raised but not yet deployed. Reservoir of future fees + investments. Record level industry-wide.
